source.text: Cedar telescope focus-map plan: fit focus position against tube temperature. Daytime calibration and nighttime star checks are jointly required for this one map.
Focus-map daytime calibration log: record tube temperature and motor position after each settling interval. Repeat one warm point to check hysteresis.
Independent Cedar site study: compare sky brightness toward four horizons to choose an observing area. Borrow the same camera, but do not use focus-map results as this survey's outcome.
Cedar sky-brightness survey clip: the camera points toward four marked horizons. A shielding board blocks light from the observatory doorway during each directional exposure.
Coat alteration: shorten the hem by three centimeters, then replace the torn lining panel so it does not pull at the vent.
OCR from a sleeved printout: filename focus-fit.csv; sleeve heading SKY BRIGHTNESS SURVEY. The table's column names are hidden by the sleeve edge.
I removed the printout from the wrong sleeve. focus-fit.csv contains tube temperature and focus motor position for the Cedar focus map; the sky-brightness heading belonged to the reused sleeve.

events.text: OCR corrected after removing the reused sleeve: focus-fit.csv contains tube temperature and focus motor position for the Cedar telescope focus map. The sleeve's SKY BRIGHTNESS SURVEY heading was not part of this printout.

source.text: Night star-check screenshot for Cedar focus map: predicted motor position yields round stars after a small constant offset. Compare against the daytime fit.
Focus-map analysis: keep the temperature slope from daytime calibration and add the constant offset seen in the star check. Update the single map deliverable.

events.reason: c07 and the corrected transcription identify the printout as focus-map data. Explicitly assign the previously unresolved scan to the focus-map project.

source.text: Cedar focus map accepted after the offset adjustment. Save the daytime log, night check and corrected focus-fit printout as the map's supporting record.
Sky-brightness survey result: the eastern horizon was darkest in this session. Repeat on a comparable clear night before selecting the site area.
Cedar sky-brightness repeat again favors the east. Deliver the directional survey and its doorway-light caveat to the site-planning group.
